title: Structured Peer Mentorship and Role Immersion Guide
author: Aisha Patel
content:
Overview:

This guide describes Redwood's Structured Peer Mentorship and Role Immersion (SPMRI) program: a repeatable, manager-aligned pathway to accelerate new hires and internal role transfers from orientation to effective, autonomous contributors. The program pairs each new hire (mentee) with a trained peer mentor and a manager-level sponsor and uses a clear curriculum, measurable outcomes, and time-boxed activities across 0–90 days.

Goals:
- Reduce median time-to-first-independent-deploy to 60 days for engineering roles and 45 days for product/BA roles.
- Provide consistent technical and cultural onboarding across teams.
- Offload manager operational burden by codifying mentor-driven role activation.
- Maintain mentor workload limits to preserve mentor productivity and fairness.

Scope:
- Applies to individual contributor hires and internal transfers in Engineering, Product, and Platform teams.
- Not a replacement for manager 1:1s, performance review processes, or role-specific training modules; it complements them.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:
- Mentee: Completes curriculum activities, documents blockers, demonstrates learning artifacts.
- Mentor (Peer): Leads immersion sessions, pairs on at least 8 focused activities in 30 days, provides weekly feedback to manager.
- Manager (Sponsor): Defines 30/60/90 outcomes, approves learning plan, conducts formal check-ins at 30/60/90 days.
- People Ops: Maintains program templates, trains mentors, monitors activation metrics.
- Engineering Onboarding Coordinator (if present): Schedules cross-team rotations and access provisioning.

Program Timeline and Milestones:
1) Pre-start (Day -7 to 0):
   - People Ops/Recruiter shares role-specific pre-reads and access checklist.
   - Manager assigns Mentor and schedules Week 1 calendar.

2) Week 0–1 (Orientation + Rapid Immersion):
   - Day 0: Welcome, account provisioning verification, quick wins list review.
   - Days 1–5: Mentor-led repo walkthroughs, local dev setup pairing, product walkthrough.
   - Deliverable: "First PR" checklist completed and merged to a non-critical repo.

3) Weeks 2–4 (Curriculum & Shadowing):
   - Mentor runs modular sessions: codebase patterns, deployment runbook, oncall basics, observability dash overview, architecture diagram walkthrough.
   - At least 4 paired programming sessions, 2 shadowed production deploys, 1 postmortem read-and-debrief.
   - Deliverable: Completed 30-day goals and a short write-up of learned architecture components.

4) Month 2 (Project Ownership & Autonomy):
   - Mentee leads a scoped ticket or small feature with mentor as reviewer.
   - Manager reevaluates 60-day outcomes and adjusts guardrails.
   - Deliverable: Feature shipped to staging or production behind a feature flag.

5) Month 3 (Independent Contribution & Handover):
   - Mentee demonstrates independent ownership of at least one recurring workflow (bug triage, oncall rotation, weekly release task).
   - Final 90-day review with manager and mentor to confirm outcomes and next objectives.

Curriculum Modules (example for Eng roles):
- Product context and success metrics
- Codebase orientation and service boundaries
- CI/CD and release process (including rollback)
- Runtime and infra (observability, SLOs, cost awareness)
- Security and compliance essentials (scanning, secrets, data handling)
- Testing, local dev productivity tips, and debugging patterns

30/60/90 Sample Objectives Template (to be filled by manager):
- 30-day: local dev + test harness set up; first PR merged; documented two architecture surfaces; attend key team rituals.
- 60-day: lead a minor feature to staging; resolve triage tickets; demonstrate understanding of SLO impacts on the service.
- 90-day: own end-to-end flow including monitoring, alert handling, and post-deploy verification; propose one improvement to the onboarding curriculum.

Mentor Load and Training:
- Recommended max concurrent mentees per mentor: 2 active mentees.
- Mentors must complete a one-hour mentor training session (People Ops) covering feedback frameworks, asynchronous coaching, bias mitigation, and escalation paths.
- Mentors receive a biannual recognition credit on the manager calibration sheet.

Operational Checklists (copyable):
- Pre-Start Checklist:
  1) Accounts provisioned (git, CI, Slack, cloud, docs).
  2) Role-specific repo access granted.
  3) Week 1 calendar shared (mentor, manager, onboarding coordinator).
  4) Pre-reads shared (architecture, runbooks, product brief).

- Week 1 Checklist:
  [ ] Local environment works end-to-end
  [ ] First PR template reviewed and PR created
  [ ] Mentor schedule confirmed for pairing sessions

- 30/60/90 Review Agenda (30 minutes):
  - 5m: Progress summary from mentee
  - 10m: Mentor feedback (strengths, gaps)
  - 10m: Manager calibrates next outcomes and support needs
  - 5m: Action items and documentation updates

Feedback and Calibration Protocols:
- Weekly asynchronous mentor notes: mentors add a short summary to the shared onboarding doc each Friday (format: wins, blockers, focus for next week).
- Managers must run a formal 30/60/90 review using the provided template (link in Related Pages).
- If a mentee is off-track at 30 days, manager + mentor create a 30-day remediation plan with measurable checkpoints every two weeks.

Escalation Path for Onboarding Blockers:
- Level 1: Mentor resolves or opens a blocker ticket in team backlog (24–48 hours).
- Level 2: If unresolved >72 hours, manager reviews and engages relevant service owner.
- Level 3: If unresolved >7 days and blocking access or safety, People Ops and Eng Ops are engaged for cross-team coordination.

Monitoring & Success Metrics (People Ops):
- Median time-to-first-independent-deploy (target: 60 days eng, 45 days product).
- Activation Score (composite 0–100) measured at day 30: account provision (20), merged PR (20), paired sessions completed (20), documented architecture notes (20), passed basic tests/runs (20). Target score >=75 at day 30.
- Mentor satisfaction and load (quarterly survey).

Templates & Examples (appendix):
- Sample Week 1 mentor schedule (text calendar).
- Sample "First PR" checklist snippet:
  * Choose non-critical repo
  * Pick issue labeled "good-first-change"
  * Create PR with description linking to onboarding ticket
  * Add reviewer and wait for CI pass
  * Merge behind feature flag or to staging branch

- Sample email to team announcing new hire (send on Day 0):
  Subject: "Welcome [Name] to [Team] — Shadowing & Pairing Schedule"
  Body: Short intro, mentor + manager contact, first-week schedule, links to pre-reads and Slack channel.

Program Governance and Continuous Improvement:
- Quarterly review (People Ops + org leads) of onboarding metrics and curriculum heatmap.
- Each team maintains a one-page "team immersion checklist" in the team wiki (template provided).
- Curriculum owners rotate annually; teams contribute updates and new examples to the central onboarding kit.

Appendix: Quick scripts and commands (Engineering)
- Verify local dev: `./scripts/dev-verify.sh` (returns 0 if environment healthy)
- Create onboarding ticket: `gh issue create --title "Onboarding: [Name] — First PR" --label onboarding`

End of document.
